discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer declaration of conformity and model identity
discovery.result: ZTE's signed declaration identifies product model nubia 8150N, MyOS13.0.0_8150N_AS1 and hardware version zatA; dated 2023-06-08. It establishes manufacturer model/software identity, not Philippine availability.

discovery.source_kind: Official product overview and feature identity
discovery.result: ZTE's official product page identifies the nubia Neo 5G, UNISOC T820, dual-SIM 5G, 22.5W charging, gaming features and design. Detailed specifications are cross-checked against ZTE's regional specification page.

discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer specifications for the exact 8150N product family
discovery.result: Official ZTE Malaysia page lists 8GB+10GB Fusion RAM (18GB advertised total), 256GB storage, UNISOC T820, Android 13, 6.6-inch FHD 120Hz display, 8MP front and 50MP+2MP rear cameras, 4500mAh battery, 22.5W charging, 163.7×75×7.98mm, dual SIM, dual-band Wi-Fi and NFC. Regional listing is not treated as proof of Philippine price or availability.

discovery.source_kind: Independent model-name, manufacturer and certified network-band match
discovery.result: GCF entry 11895 maps ZTE Corporation model nubia 8150N to marketing name nubia Neo 5G and lists certified cellular bands. Certification date 2023-11-25. Band data describes the certified model and does not guarantee Philippine carrier compatibility.

discovery.source_kind: Chipset architecture and Southeast Asian launch timing
discovery.result: UNISOC release dated 2023-07-27 states ZTE had launched the nubia Neo 5G in Southeast Asia and details the T820: 1× Cortex-A76 at 2.7GHz, 3× Cortex-A76 at 2.3GHz, 4× Cortex-A55 at 2.1GHz, Mali-G57 MP4 up to 850MHz and 6nm EUV process.
ZTE Device Thailand said preorders for the nubia Neo 5G would be available through online channels in June 2023. This establishes month-level regional preorder timing, not an exact first-sale day.

discovery.source_kind: Contemporaneous Philippine official-store sale, list price, promotion and configuration
discovery.result: Article dated 2023-09-06 reports a live-sale observation of ZTE Philippines selling the nubia Neo 5G on TikTok Shop: PHP 9,999 list price and limited-time PHP 8,599 promotional price. It identifies 8GB physical RAM, 256GB storage, 8MP selfie camera, 50MP rear camera, 4500mAh battery and 22.5W charge.

discovery.source_kind: Philippine marketplace listing, configuration and detailed specifications
discovery.result: Article dated 2023-09-14 reports the 8GB/256GB nubia Neo 5G listed in Lazada Philippines for PHP 9,799. Its prose states 6.6-inch 120Hz IPS LCD and 8MP front camera; its spec table gives 6.73-inch, 2408×1080, LPDDR5x and UFS 3.1, so inconsistent entries from that page are not silently combined.

discovery.source_kind: Philippine price and independent specification cross-check
discovery.result: Article dated 2023-09-11 reports PHP 9,999 SRP, 8GB/256GB, 6.6-inch FHD+ 120Hz display, 13MP front camera, 4500mAh and 22.5W. Its front-camera value conflicts with ZTE's product page and other contemporaneous PH launch sources; that field remains unresolved.

discovery.source_kind: Philippine retail pricing and local product specifications
discovery.result: Article dated 2023-09-09 reports PHP 9,999 in ZTE's TikTok Shop listing, 6.67-inch/2400×1080/120Hz display, 8GB/256GB, 8MP front camera, 4500mAh and 22.5W. This pixel resolution conflicts with YugaTech's spec table.

discovery.source_kind: Pre-release reporting retained to distinguish provisional estimates from final specifications
discovery.result: August 2023 preview described 13MP selfie camera, 5000mAh and 33W charging before Philippine retail availability. These pre-release estimates are superseded by later ZTE product specifications and contemporaneous PH retail sources, and are not used as final configuration values.

discovery.source_kind: Independent exact-model specification and physical-weight cross-check
discovery.result: Article dated 2024-02-13 identifies the nubia Neo 5G 8GB/256GB, lists a 189g weight, 6.6-inch LCD 120Hz display, 8MP front camera, 50MP+2MP rear cameras, Android 13, 4500mAh and 22.5W charging. It does not establish Philippine pricing or configuration-specific local availability.

Checked 2026-11-27. The current nubia official-store search results show newer Neo 5-series models, but no exact older nubia Neo 5G (8150N) listing or current PHP price. No current price is asserted from this non-matching search page.

prices.excerpt: REVU observed ZTE Philippines selling the 8GB/256GB nubia Neo 5G on TikTok Shop at PHP 9,999 list price.
REVU recorded a time-limited PHP 8,599 TikTok Shop offer during the official ZTE Philippines live sale; the report described it as a limited-time promotion.
YugaTech reported the exact 8GB/256GB nubia Neo 5G listing at PHP 9,799 on Lazada Philippines on 2023-09-14.
